capabilities: Ask questions about the vault and get answers with inline citation pills
Jump from a citation to the cited note at the exact paragraph
Rank notes per question with BM25 and send only the top matches to Anthropic
Configure model, token limits, folder scope, and system prompt
Cache large note context so follow-up questions are cheaper and faster
extras: Not yet approved in the community plugins browser; manual installation from release files is described, and the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI question answering, and typical chat-with-notes plugins rely on the model to attribute claims, so cited sources can be wrong or hallucinated.
summary: AI chat over your vault that answers questions with verified citations to exact notes and passages, powered by Anthropic's Citations API.
